title: PH posts P13.7-billion budget surplus in October; 10-month deficit hits P1.29 trillion
summary: The Philippines booked a wider budget surplus of P13.7 billion in October as revenue collections outpaced state spending, data from the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) showed Wednesday.
